title: Bob Baker Marionette Theater Variety Show
tips:
Registration is recommended.
Walk-ins are also welcome.
audiences: Adults; Teens; Seniors; Babies; Preschoolers; All Ages; Tweens; Children; Families; Toddlers
description: Bob Baker Marionette Theater is bringing the puppet magic to the Mountain View Public Library. This variety show will be roughly 30 minutes long and feature between 12 and 25 puppets from their iconic collection! After the show, there will be a quick 15 minute Q&A. This magical show will take place in Pioneer Park. Feel free to bring a fold-out chair, towel, or blanket for your comfort out in the park. This type of fun has no age limit! This event is generously sponsored by the Friends of the Mountain View Library.

title: Smart Start Babytime
tips:
Smart Start Babytime is a special program for babies (0–2) and their caregivers that blends stories, songs, and early play with different information each week with a pediatric resident from Stanford Medical School.
Caregivers will gain practical tips, build confidence, and have the opportunity to ask questions—all in a warm, supportive environment designed for your baby’s earliest learning.

title: Mid-Autumn Festival Story Celebration
description: Celebrate the magic of the Mid-Autumn Festival with PiggySprout! Join Tianxin (Aries) Wang (苗苗姐姐) for immersive Mandarin stories that bring the rich traditions of Asian culture to life. Drawing upon her advanced academic background in language acquisition, Aries curates an interactive experience featuring beautifully illustrated picture books, cultural connection, and engaging hands-on activities. This session is thoughtfully designed to foster early language development while helping children build a joyful, lasting connection to their cultural roots. Whether you are seeking to strengthen your family's heritage or introduce your child to a new language in a welcoming community space, this festive gathering promises a memorable and educational experience.
